Economy · India

Tata Steel Expands Indian Capacity, Other Firms Report Earnings

Tata Steel has cleared funds for the expansion of Neelachal Ispat Nigam, aiming to boost its steel production capacity in India. This development comes as several companies reported their quarterly earnings. Tata Steel itself beat profit expectations due to improved steel prices. Separately, Indian Railway Finance Corporation (IRFC) saw a 10% rise in net profit for Q1 FY27. International firms like AstraZeneca, UBS, and Mastercard also reported earnings that met or exceeded expectations, driven by factors such as cancer medicine sales and stable consumer spending.
